analysis_walkthrough.business_objective_summary: The objective is to perform a smoke test to validate the generation of the analyst_report_v2 artifact.
requirements_understanding: The smoke test should ensure that the analyst_report_v2 artifact is generated without errors.
The test should be automated and provide clear pass/fail results.
The artifact generation process should be observable and include error handling.
conversion_to_technical_requirements: Implement a test suite that triggers the artifact generation and checks for successful completion.
Ensure logging and monitoring are in place to capture any errors during the generation process.
Define clear acceptance criteria for what constitutes a successful artifact generation.
clarifications_requested: What specific data or inputs are required to generate the analyst_report_v2 artifact?
Are there any specific performance benchmarks that the artifact generation must meet?

output.executive_summary: This project aims to validate the generation of the analyst_report_v2 artifact through a comprehensive smoke test, ensuring reliability and error-free execution.

functional_requirements.title: Trigger Artifact Generation
functional_requirements.description: The system must be able to trigger the generation of the analyst_report_v2 artifact.
acceptance_criteria: The artifact generation can be initiated via a command-line interface.
The artifact generation can be initiated via an API call.
The system logs the initiation of the artifact generation process.

functional_requirements.title: Validate Artifact Generation Completion
functional_requirements.description: The system must validate that the analyst_report_v2 artifact is generated successfully.
acceptance_criteria: The system confirms the presence of the generated artifact in the specified output directory.
The system verifies the integrity of the generated artifact.
The system logs a success message upon successful generation.

functional_requirements.title: Error Handling During Generation
functional_requirements.description: The system must handle errors that occur during the artifact generation process.
acceptance_criteria: The system logs any errors encountered during the generation process.
The system provides a descriptive error message to the user.
The system retries the generation process up to three times upon failure.

functional_requirements.title: Automated Smoke Test Execution
functional_requirements.description: The system must support automated execution of the smoke test for artifact generation.
acceptance_criteria: The smoke test can be executed automatically via a CI/CD pipeline.
The smoke test results are logged and accessible for review.
The smoke test provides a clear pass/fail result.

functional_requirements.title: Logging of Artifact Generation Process
functional_requirements.description: The system must log the entire artifact generation process for observability.
acceptance_criteria: The system logs the start and end time of the artifact generation.
The system logs any warnings or non-critical issues encountered.
The logs are stored in a centralized logging system.

functional_requirements.title: Notification on Test Completion
functional_requirements.description: The system must notify stakeholders upon completion of the smoke test.
acceptance_criteria: The system sends an email notification upon test completion.
The notification includes the test results and any errors encountered.
The notification is sent to a predefined list of stakeholders.

functional_requirements.title: Configuration Management for Test Parameters
functional_requirements.description: The system must allow configuration of test parameters for the smoke test.
acceptance_criteria: The system allows configuration of the output directory for the artifact.
The system allows configuration of retry attempts for error handling.
The system allows configuration of notification recipients.

functional_requirements.title: Artifact Format Validation
functional_requirements.description: The system must validate the format of the generated analyst_report_v2 artifact.
acceptance_criteria: The system checks that the artifact is in the expected file format (e.g., PDF, DOCX).
The system verifies that the artifact contains all required sections.
The system logs any format discrepancies found.

non_functional_requirements.title: Performance of Artifact Generation
non_functional_requirements.description: The artifact generation process must complete within a reasonable time frame.
acceptance_criteria: The artifact generation process completes within the specified time frame under normal load.
Performance metrics are logged for each generation process.
The system alerts if the generation time exceeds the threshold.

non_functional_requirements.title: System Reliability
non_functional_requirements.description: The system must be reliable and available for artifact generation.
acceptance_criteria: The system maintains the specified uptime over a 30-day period.
Downtime incidents are logged and reported.
The system automatically recovers from failures.

non_functional_requirements.title: Security of Artifact Data
non_functional_requirements.description: The system must ensure the security of data used in artifact generation.
non_functional_requirements.metric: Data is encrypted in transit and at rest.
acceptance_criteria: All data transmissions are encrypted using TLS.
Generated artifacts are stored in an encrypted format.
Access to artifact data is restricted to authorized users.

non_functional_requirements.title: Usability of Test Execution
non_functional_requirements.description: The smoke test execution process must be user-friendly.
non_functional_requirements.metric: User satisfaction score of 4.5/5 for test execution interface.
acceptance_criteria: Users can execute the smoke test with minimal training.
The test execution interface is intuitive and easy to navigate.
User feedback is collected and analyzed for improvements.

non_functional_requirements.title: Scalability of Artifact Generation
non_functional_requirements.description: The system must scale to handle increased demand for artifact generation.
non_functional_requirements.metric: System can handle a 100% increase in artifact generation requests.
acceptance_criteria: The system maintains performance under increased load.
Load testing results are documented and reviewed.
The system can be scaled horizontally to accommodate demand.

recommended_strategy.name: Phased modernization
recommended_strategy.rationale: Preserve behavior first, then modernize in controlled phases.

phases.title: Baseline and equivalence harness
phases.outcome: Capture golden flows and baseline outputs.

phases.title: Incremental migration and dependency replacement
phases.outcome: Migrate forms/modules with dependency risk controls.

phases.title: Hardening and release evidence
phases.outcome: Finalize quality gates and publish evidence pack.

blocking.question: Target UI framework selection for migrated forms
blocking.default_recommendation: WinForms for lowest event-model delta from VB6 unless UX redesign is in scope.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: High rework risk in form/event parity and control migration.

blocking.question: ActiveX/OCX replacement strategy by dependency
blocking.default_recommendation: Replace common controls and isolate only high-risk dependencies behind adapters.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: Runtime regressions and release delays from unresolved control behavior.

blocking.question: Database contract strategy during migration
blocking.default_recommendation: Preserve contracts initially and modernize behind a compatibility layer.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: Business rule drift and data-side regressions.

blocking.question: What are target latency, throughput, and availability SLOs?
blocking.default_recommendation: Resolve with product/business owner before implementation commitment.

non_blocking.question: Logging and observability stack for migrated runtime
non_blocking.default_recommendation: OpenTelemetry + structured logs for parity troubleshooting.
